Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The patient
reported immediate neck and low back pain with stiffness. The mechanism and force of the impact are consistent with the injuries
described. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, while neurological
screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. Imaging was not indicated at the time of initial evaluation.
The patient also reports a remote soft tissue strain to the same region that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Care
consisted of six office visits including manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction. Recovery has been gradual, and
the course of treatment extended somewhat beyond what is typical for this type of strain. Billing records reflect single charges for
each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. Current assessment is a cervical and lumbar strain with ongoing improvement;
further follow-up will be determined based on progress.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
